subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Selkies and Skin-Changers
description: A fast breakdown of Selkies and Skin-Changers for builders.

hook.text: Scottish selkies are seals who shed their skin and become human on land. Hide the skin, trap the selkie.

buildup.text: Selkie stories often involve a man stealing the skin. The selkie wife stays until she finds it—then returns to the sea.

discovery.text: Skin-changers appear in Irish, Norse, and Native American myth. The boundary between human and animal is a zipper.

twist.text: Berserkers wore bearskins and became bear-like in battle. The skin wasn't disguise—it was transformation.

climax.text: Skin-changing myths ask: is identity fixed? Or is the self just another garment you can put on and take off?

punchline.text: Change the skin. Change the self.

quiz.question: How can a selkie be trapped on land?
